responsibility: This target configuration header defines MIPS Linux dynamic-linker names, linker emulations, musl/uClibc/glibc/bionic path selection, and executable-stack indication policy. It is the Linux-specific ABI/runtime companion to the broader GNU-user and linux-common headers, concentrating on loader-path selection and ELF executable-stack semantics for different MIPS ABIs, endianness, ISA revisions, and NaN encodings.
